race.description: Brain Foundation Markets 15/11 Spring Cup (Bm82) Hcp
race.comment: CONCOCTION (7) has been in the market at his last couple of starts but hasn't made an impression, last start finishing seventh over 1400m at Moree. Rates highly on best figures and can improve sharply. The well-related KAIHOKO (4) (half to G2 winner Good Standing) settled well back from a wide draw last time then wound up strongly to finish fifth over 1200m at Tuncurry. Strips fitter second-up and is among the main chances. IRON HAT (9) finished second last time over 1000m at Muswellbrook when resuming from a spell, beaten 3 lengths. Strips fitter and is certainly one for the exotics players. TAIPAN LEGEND (3) best of the rest while fresh.
